Mod.Name: Triple Triad Rule Select
Mod.Author: BreDoyliesSea
Mod.Description:
Pick the Triple Triad rules yourself, in Junction VIII's mod configuration.
• Open, Same, Plus, Random, Sudden Death, Same Wall, Elemental: each one Region default, Always on or Always off. • Trade rule: Region default, One, Diff, Direct, All, or None (no cards change hands). • Applies to every card game in every region. "Region default" keeps the game's own rule spreading and abolishing.
Requires the Steam 2013 English release (FF8_EN.exe). Not for the Remastered edition, other languages or the 2000 release.
